conceptBlocks.text: 按2025年线上订单会话来源汇总净销售及毛利，并与同年广告支出对齐；广告后贡献为毛利减广告，贡献率以净销售为分母。

syntax.purpose: 渠道广告后的贡献利润的语法模板如下，各部分含义见下方说明。

problem: 渠道负责人希望比较2025年线上订单按会话归因的净销售、毛利及扣除当年广告费后的贡献，识别高销售但广告后亏损的渠道，并分析退款风险。

methodBlocks.text: a 从订单净额视图连接会话，按订单日期选定2025年线上订单，按来源汇总净额及净额减成本。会话编号须唯一；丢失会话的订单不进入内连接结果。
b 按广告月份独立汇总支出，避免同渠道多笔订单与多笔广告直接相乘。以渠道主档左连接两份汇总，无记录且确认数据完整时补零。贡献金额=毛利−广告支出；
贡献率以净销售为分母，NULLIF 防止零分母，乘100.0 后再四舍五入。无销售但有广告的渠道仍显示负贡献。按金额而非比率降序排列。
同一报告期使用订单日期与广告月份，并非要求会话也发生在该年；来源归因不证明广告导致销售。退款专题回到折后扣退款前的金额与原销售成本，分别汇总退款与实际冲回成本；
净成本已冲回时不能再次加回。先核实退款统计截止和成本冲回口径。

SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;

breakdown.title: 计算广告后的贡献利润与占比
breakdown.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT s.source_id,SUM(o.net_cents) net,SUM(o.net_cents-o.cost_cents) gross FROM v_order_net o JOIN customer_sessions s ON s.session_id=o.session_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.source_id), b AS (SELECT source_id,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY source_id) SELECT t.source_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.gross,0) gross_cents,COALESCE(b.spend,0) spend_cents,COALESCE(a.gross,0)-COALESCE(b.spend,0) contribution_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.gross,0)-COALESCE(b.spend,0))/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) contribution_pct FROM traffic_sources t LEFT JOIN a ON a.source_id=t.source_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.source_id=t.source_id ORDER BY contribution_cents DESC

resultBlocks.text: 渠道1净销售1000分，毛利400分，无广告支出，贡献400分、贡献率40%。渠道2净销售800分、毛利350分，但广告支出400分，贡献−50分、贡献率−6.25%。
渠道3无销售仍支出100分，贡献−100分，贡献率为空；渠道4无记录但主档保留，贡献0、比率为空。
退款示例中渠道1折后销售1000、成本600、退款200、成本冲回120，退款率20%，毛利由400降至320，下降80而非200。缺少会话示例有2笔、200分未归因，应另行核查。
原企业结果渠道1贡献10543653分、贡献率38.73%，只是广告后贡献，不是净利润；零广告也不意味着没有其他获客成本。

extensions.label: 完整广告后贡献报表

explanationBlocks.text: 先分别聚合，再连接主档。贡献为毛利减广告；净销售为零时比率为空。

extensions.sql:
WITH traffic_sources(source_id) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4),
customer_sessions(session_id,source_id) AS (SELECT 11,1 UNION ALL SELECT 12,2),
v_order_net(order_id,session_id,channel,order_date,net_cents,cost_cents) AS (
 SELECT 1,11,'online','2025-01-10',600,350 UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,11,'online','2025-02-10',400,250 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,12,'online','2025-03-10',800,450 UNION ALL
 SELECT 4,12,'store','2025-03-10',999,100 UNION ALL
 SELECT 5,12,'online','2024-12-31',999,100),
marketing_campaigns(source_id,month_key,spend_cents) AS (
 SELECT 2,'2025-01',200 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-02',200 UNION ALL
 SELECT 3,'2025-03',100 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2024-12',999),
a AS (SELECT s.source_id,SUM(o.net_cents) net,SUM(o.net_cents-o.cost_cents) gross FROM v_order_net o JOIN customer_sessions s ON s.session_id=o.session_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.source_id),
b AS (SELECT source_id,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY source_id)
SELECT t.source_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.gross,0) gross_cents,COALESCE(b.spend,0) spend_cents,COALESCE(a.gross,0)-COALESCE(b.spend,0) contribution_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.gross,0)-COALESCE(b.spend,0))/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) contribution_pct FROM traffic_sources t LEFT JOIN a ON a.source_id=t.source_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.source_id=t.source_id ORDER BY contribution_cents DESC

extensions.label: 退款率与退款前后毛利

explanationBlocks.text: 退款率分母为折后扣退款前销售；退货成本加回须依据实际成本冲回，示例假设全部可冲回。

extensions.sql:
WITH sources(id) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3),
lines(source_id,discounted_cents,original_cost,refund_cents,returned_cost) AS (
 SELECT 1,1000,600,200,120 UNION ALL SELECT 2,800,450,0,0),
a AS (SELECT source_id,SUM(discounted_cents) before_sales,SUM(refund_cents) refunded,SUM(original_cost) before_cost,SUM(returned_cost) cost_reversed FROM lines GROUP BY source_id),
z AS (SELECT id,COALESCE(before_sales,0) before_sales,COALESCE(refunded,0) refunded,COALESCE(before_cost,0) before_cost,COALESCE(cost_reversed,0) cost_reversed FROM sources LEFT JOIN a ON id=source_id)
SELECT id,before_sales,refunded,ROUND(100.0*refunded/NULLIF(before_sales,0),2) refund_pct,before_sales-before_cost gross_before,before_sales-refunded-before_cost+cost_reversed gross_after FROM z ORDER BY before_sales

comparison.text: 毛利率、广告后贡献率及广告投入产出比的分子不同；广告后贡献不是最终净利润。退款率采用折后扣退款前销售额。

example.text: 直接连接订单与广告明细；用净销售作为退款率分母；把广告后贡献当作净利润。
